notes: Cross-verse split with PSA.37.24: שִׁנָּיו is the bare direct object of חֹרֵק in the Hebrew (BDB: gnash, with שִׁנַּיִם as object; Lam 2:16, Ps 35:16), and the ASV recasts it as an instrument with a supplied 'with' exactly as it recasts יָדוֹ after סוֹמֵךְ in 37.24. Rule 33's direct-object paragraph sends that preposition to the verb's unit under rule 44 whatever preposition was chosen; the noun keeps only 'teeth'.
